questions.q: During formal negotiations for a major government contract, which role should exclusively have the authority to make binding commitments on behalf of the agency?
options: The Lead Technical Subject Matter Expert
The Lead Negotiator (typically the Procurement Officer)
The highest-ranking vendor executive in the room
questions.explain: The Lead Negotiator, usually a warranted contracting or procurement officer, is the only team member authorized to formally commit the agency, control the flow of the negotiation, and accept concessions.
